title: Delivery agent asking for delivery OTP

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello sir, Amazon delivery, I am at your gate with your package.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Okay sir, please tell me the delivery OTP when you come, it is on the SMS.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Cash on delivery amount is 1,299 rupees, you can pay by UPI also.
